Drug interaction between omeprazole and methotrexate: a case report and a review of the literature
YUAN Zheng 1 ，XU Jing 2 ，QIU Jin-chun2( 1 Zhengzhou Maternity and Child Health Hospital，Zhengzhou 450003，China; 2 Nanjing Children ’ s Hospital Affiliated to Nanjing Medical University，Nanjing 210008，China)［Abstract］ Objestive: To discuss the mechanisms and clinical features of interaction between omeprazole and methotrexate( MTX) in order to provide references for rational use of proton pump inhibitors( PPIs) and MTX． Methods: One case of decreased elimination of MTX potentially induced by a drug interaction between methotrexate and omeprazole in a 9-year-old boy was analyzed and evaluated． Published literatures were searched for cases reports of interaction between PPIs and MTX through CNKI，WanFang Database，and Pubmed Database from 1990 to 2015． Results: Only 10 case reports were collected including two in China． Omeprazole may delay MTX elimination; therefore，when prescribing MTX，an alternative to omeprazole should be considered． Conclusion: Physicians should be alerted to this potential drug interaction in patients receiving concomitant PPIs and high-dose methotrexate．DNA 的合成，临床广泛用于白血病、淋巴瘤、骨肉瘤等恶性肿瘤的治疗。 MTX 单用或与其他药物合用，可选择用于急性淋巴细胞白血病( acute lymphoblas-tic leukemia，ALL) 的巩固维持治疗 。 大剂量 MTX可使药物透过血脑屏障，提高脑脊液中药物的浓度，发挥预防中枢神经系统白血病( CNSL) 的作用在国内外 ALL 的实践指南或诊疗建议中，临床多采用 MTX 联合阿糖胞苷或 6-巯嘌呤等发挥抗肿瘤作用，辅以水化、碱化、亚叶酸钙等治疗［2 － 3］。 当患者在化疗前伴有胃肠系疾病或预防化疗引起的胃肠道不良反应时，临床可能同时或先后用到质子泵抑制剂( proton pump inhibitor，PPI) 。
